title: It’s a perfect day when it starts with an easy breakfast
summary: … Just mix A little grated carrot (@omielifeinc plate)
caption: 🎶 It’s a perfect day when it starts with an easy breakfast… Just mix: 🥚 1 egg 🥕 A little grated carrot 🧀 A pinch of shredded cheese Pour it into your waffle maker, cook for 3 minutes, and breakfast is DONE. Perfect for busy mornings when you need something quick, easy, and nourishing. Save this one for your next breakfast rush! ❤️ (@omielifeinc plate)  #ToddlerBreakfast #EasyToddlerMeals #ToddlerFood
